tasks.title: Task 1.1 — Dynamic Array Implementation
tasks.instruction_text: Implement a simple dynamic (resizable) array class in Python that supports append(), get(index), and automatically resizes its internal storage when full.
tasks.starter_code:
class DynamicArray:
    def __init__(self):
        self.capacity = 2
        self.size = 0
        self.array = [None] * self.capacity

    def append(self, value):
        if self.size == self.capacity:
            self.capacity *= 2
            new_array = [None] * self.capacity
            for i in range(self.size):
                new_array[i] = self.array[i]
            self.array = new_array
        self.array[self.size] = value
        self.size += 1

    def get(self, index):
        if index < 0 or index >= self.size:
            raise IndexError("Index out of bounds")
        return self.array[index]

arr = DynamicArray()
arr.append(10)
arr.append(20)
arr.append(30)
print(arr.get(0))
print(arr.get(2))
print(arr.capacity)
print(arr.size)

tasks.title: Task 1.2 — Reverse an Array In-Place
tasks.instruction_text: Write a function reverse_array(arr) that reverses the elements of a list in place, without using Python's built-in reverse() or slicing tricks.
tasks.starter_code:
def reverse_array(arr):
    left, right = 0, len(arr) - 1
    while left < right:
        arr[left], arr[right] = arr[right], arr[left]
        left += 1
        right -= 1
    return arr

print(reverse_array([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]))
print(reverse_array([7, 2]))

tasks.title: Task 2.1 — Singly Linked List: Node and Insertion
tasks.instruction_text: Implement a Node class and a SinglyLinkedList class with insert_at_head(value) and insert_at_tail(value) methods.
tasks.starter_code:
class Node:
    def __init__(self, value):
        self.value = value
        self.next = None

class SinglyLinkedList:
    def __init__(self):
        self.head = None

    def insert_at_head(self, value):
        new_node = Node(value)
        new_node.next = self.head
        self.head = new_node

    def insert_at_tail(self, value):
        new_node = Node(value)
        if self.head is None:
            self.head = new_node
            return
        current = self.head
        while current.next is not None:
            current = current.next
        current.next = new_node

sll = SinglyLinkedList()
sll.insert_at_tail(1)
sll.insert_at_tail(2)
sll.insert_at_head(0)
current = sll.head
parts = []
while current is not None:
    parts.append(str(current.value))
    current = current.next
parts.append("None")
print(" -> ".join(parts))

tasks.title: Task 2.3 — Doubly Linked List Implementation
tasks.instruction_text: Implement a DoublyLinkedList class with prev/next pointers, supporting insertion and deletion at both the head and tail.
tasks.starter_code:
class DNode:
    def __init__(self, value):
        self.value = value
        self.prev = None
        self.next = None

class DoublyLinkedList:
    def __init__(self):
        self.head = None
        self.tail = None

    def insert_at_head(self, value):
        new_node = DNode(value)
        if self.head is None:
            self.head = self.tail = new_node
            return
        new_node.next = self.head
        self.head.prev = new_node
        self.head = new_node

    def insert_at_tail(self, value):
        new_node = DNode(value)
        if self.tail is None:
            self.head = self.tail = new_node
            return
        new_node.prev = self.tail
        self.tail.next = new_node
        self.tail = new_node

    def delete_head(self):
        if self.head is None:
            return
        if self.head is self.tail:
            self.head = self.tail = None
            return
        self.head = self.head.next
        self.head.prev = None

    def delete_tail(self):
        if self.tail is None:
            return
        if self.head is self.tail:
            self.head = self.tail = None
            return
        self.tail = self.tail.prev
        self.tail.next = None

dll = DoublyLinkedList()
dll.insert_at_tail(1)
dll.insert_at_tail(2)
dll.insert_at_head(0)
current = dll.head
parts = []
while current is not None:
    parts.append(str(current.value))
    current = current.next
print(" <-> ".join(parts))
dll.delete_tail()
current = dll.head
parts = []
while current is not None:
    parts.append(str(current.value))
    current = current.next
print(" <-> ".join(parts))

tasks.title: Task 4.2 — Recursion: Tower of Hanoi
tasks.instruction_text: Implement the Tower of Hanoi solution using recursion, printing each move as 'Move disk X from Y to Z'.
tasks.starter_code:
def hanoi(n, source, auxiliary, target):
    if n == 0:
        return
    hanoi(n - 1, source, target, auxiliary)
    print(f"Move disk {n} from {source} to {target}")
    hanoi(n - 1, auxiliary, source, target)

hanoi(2, 'A', 'B', 'C')
tasks.expected_output:
Move disk 1 from A to B
Move disk 2 from A to C
Move disk 1 from B to C
